Izumi Seinikuten / How it works

How all-you-can-eat works

For first-time guests and visitors from overseas: what happens from the moment you sit down until you pay.

  1. Choose a course

    Pick one of the five courses for the whole table. This is also when you decide whether to add all-you-can-drink.

  2. Order what you like

    Order anything in your course as many times as you like. We suggest ordering a little at a time, as much as you can finish.

  3. Grill at your table

    You grill the meat yourself. Three sauces are provided: garlic soy, salt, and grated daikon. Please use separate chopsticks or tongs for raw meat.

  4. Last order at 90 minutes

    We take your last order 90 minutes after you start: one dish and one drink per person. Dessert can be ordered here, too.

  5. Pay at 120 minutes

    Pay once at the end. Cards, QR payments and transit IC cards are accepted.

House rules

  • 120 minutes in total. Orders are taken for the first 90 minutes.
  • Everyone at the table takes the same course.
  • At last order, each guest may order one dish and one drink.
  • A charge applies if a large amount of food is left uneaten.
  • Chicken sashimi is limited to one plate per person.

For visitors from overseas

  • Menus are written in Japanese, English and Chinese.
  • UnionPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and major credit cards are accepted.
  • Walk-ins are welcome, but we cannot seat you when we are full. Booking by phone is the sure way.

Questions & answers

Do you have menus in other languages?

Yes. Our menus are written in Japanese, English and Chinese.

Can we bring children? Is there a child price?

There are discounts for children and guests aged 65 and over. Please call us for the details.

Reserve by phone. Same-day tables can be checked, too.

Phone lines open at 16:00. Courses are for two or more guests; table-only reservations are accepted from one guest.
